mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 150k signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 150k in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to produce a Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in private demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 700k and RSAFS > 400k in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 97.0 (index 2017=100) over two consecutive months signals improving manufacturing output and supply chain stability, which reduces earnings volatility and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during sustained INDPRO > 97.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the year-over-year growth of real personal consumption (proxied by RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which increases the risk of corporate revenue misses and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS yoy growth < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal produces a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stagnant monetary policy (FEDFUNDS unchanged) indicates a failure of monetary tightening to curb inflation, increasing real interest rate uncertainty and reducing equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS unchanged for 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both CPIAUCSL > 2.5% yoy and FEDFUNDS unchanged (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 8.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS declines > 50k in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS declines > 50k (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, combined with a decline in housing starts, signals a weakening economy, which increases recession risk and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 qoq < 1.0% and HOUST declines > 2% m/m
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 < 1.0% qoq and HOUST declines > 2% m/m (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).
